title: Question 12
passage:
I can bring your grocery order up after dinner.
A. I bought groceries at that store last week. B. Dinner usually takes about half an hour. C. Could you bring the frozen items up now?
passageZh:

A. 我上週有去那家店買雜貨。
B. 晚餐通常會吃半個小時左右。
C. 冷凍食品可以現在就先幫我拿上來嗎？
